description:
Fetch upstream and downstream relationships for an asset in the Aiven context catalog. Identify the asset with `asset_id` or `urn`, and use `direction` and `depth` to control the traversal.

Responses may suggest follow-up actions. Only call the `aiven_context_*` tools. To pass an asset from a response to another tool, use its `urn` value or its `id`.

`organization_id` is the `organization_id` of a project from `aiven_project_list`. The tool works only for organizations with the Aiven context catalog enabled. On a `context_catalog_not_enabled` or `context_service_not_found` error, do not call other `aiven_context_*` tools for that organization.

organization_id.description: Aiven organization ID, from the `organization_id` field of `aiven_project_list`.
